description.zh: 创建文档解析任务时返回的任务ID（DtsJobId）。
description.en: The task ID (DtsJobId) returned when the document parsing task was created.
The instance ID of the DTS RagFlow instance.

description.zh: 任务所属的地域ID，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID of the task. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

title.zh: 获取文档解析任务的结果
title.en: Retrieve the result of a document parsing task

descriptions.zh:
此接口对调用次数有限制，超过限制后的调用会被拒绝。
- 单个地域累计允许调用的阈值为100 次/秒。
- 单个地域允许单个账号调用的阈值为5 次/秒。
descriptions.en:
This operation has rate limits. Calls that exceed the limits are rejected.
- The cumulative call threshold per region is 100 calls per second.
- The call threshold per account per region is 5 calls per second.
